Headline: Droughts Drowning The US

I noticed in this map of the U.S. the states on the east and west coasts are only experiencing moderate or abnormal droughts. However, when looking toward the north and south of the U.S., they are experiencing more extreme and violent droughts. I wonder why this is the case and what has been causing droughts all over the U.S. This is extremely relevant to me because I live in an area experiencing moderate droughts, so it is heavily impacting my community and the weather in my area.
